scenario.zh: 为新产品型号部署精密装配工作站，输入任务需求和零件特征，获得可立即训练的机器人配置方案
scenario.en: Deploy a precision assembly station for a new product model by providing task requirements and part characteristics to receive a ready-to-train robotic configuration

instruction.zh: 选择需要自动化的精密装配场景
instruction.en: Select the precision assembly scenario to automate

output.zh: 识别柔性材料特征，规划穿孔路径
output.en: Identifies flexible material traits, plans threading path

input.zh: 0.3mm柔性排线需穿过直径0.5mm孔位，材料易弯曲，孔位公差±0.05mm，需保持排线平整无折痕
input.en: 0.3mm flex cable must thread through 0.5mm diameter hole, material bends easily, hole tolerance ±0.05mm, cable must stay flat without creasing

output.zh: 视觉系统：微米级孔位定位+排线姿态检测 / 运动规划：柔性材料张力控制+三轴对齐策略 / 仿真训练：500组弯曲变形场景
output.en: Vision: micron-level hole detection + cable posture tracking / Motion: flexible material tension control + tri-axis alignment / Simulation: 500 bending deformation scenarios

output.zh: 定位微小卡扣位置，控制扣合力度
output.en: Locates tiny latch points, controls snapping force

input.zh: 1.2mm连接器帽需扣接到PCB插座，卡扣位置4个，每个0.8mm宽，扣合需听到咔哒声，过度用力会损坏
input.en: 1.2mm connector cap must snap onto PCB socket, 4 latch points each 0.8mm wide, must hear click sound, excessive force causes damage

output.zh: 视觉系统：四点卡扣对齐检测+高速力反馈 / 运动规划：渐进施力曲线+声学确认触发 / 仿真训练：200组角度偏差+力度边界测试
output.en: Vision: four-point latch alignment + high-speed force feedback / Motion: progressive force curve + acoustic confirmation / Simulation: 200 angle deviation + force boundary tests

instruction.zh: 查看传统编程与AI工作站的配置差异
instruction.en: Review configuration differences between traditional programming and AI station

output.zh: 显示配置周期和适应能力的实际差距
output.en: Shows real gaps in setup cycles and adaptation capability

output.zh: 数周：硬编码每个动作路径，反复调试参数，型号变更需重新编写
output.en: Weeks: hard-code each motion path, iterative parameter tuning, model changes require rewriting

output.zh: 通过仿真训练快速适应新任务
output.en: Rapidly adapts to new tasks via simulation training

output.zh: 几分钟：仿真引擎自动生成策略，基础模型理解任务上下文，零件变化时快速重新训练
output.en: Minutes: simulation engine auto-generates strategy, foundation model understands task context, rapid retraining when parts change

instruction.zh: 查看实际生产线部署的精度和速度
instruction.en: Review precision and speed from actual production deployment

output.zh: 达到人类速度且完全准确
output.en: Matches human speed with full accuracy

input.zh: 全球热门智能手机屏幕保护膜剥离，0.1mm薄膜需无气泡撕除，边缘无残留胶痕，此任务制造商数年未能自动化
input.en: Screen protector peeling for popular global smartphone, 0.1mm film must be removed bubble-free, no adhesive residue on edges, task manufacturer couldn't automate for years

output.zh: 速度与熟练工人相当，准确率达到完美标准，无需人工返工，已在量产线稳定运行
output.en: Speed matches skilled workers, accuracy reaches perfect standard, no manual rework needed, stable in mass production

takeaway.zh: 本示例展示了任务配置和部署周期对比（虚构场景），实际性能数据、仿真引擎细节和客户产线需在Industrial Next官网确认
takeaway.en: This demo illustrated task configuration and deployment comparison (fictional scenarios); actual performance data, simulation engine details and customer lines must be verified on Industrial Next site
